# [TASK] Fix unbound property blocks in the served movie-service.yml

## Task
In `backend/config-service/src/main/resources/config/movie-service.yml`, the
dev and prod profile documents put `mongodb:` and `redis:` at the top level of
the document, as siblings of `spring:`. Spring binds neither, so
`MONGODB_URI`, `REDIS_HOST`, `REDIS_PORT` and `REDIS_PASSWORD` are discarded
for the one service that actually reads from the config server.

Correct keys for Spring Boot 4: `spring.mongodb.uri` and `spring.data.redis.*`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The dev and prod documents nest these keys under `spring:` using the Boot 4 names
- [x] A test asserts the served values land under the keys movie-service reads
- [x] No other property prefixes are changed

## Estimate
**Hours:** 1

## Notes
Verified: `config-service/src/main/resources/config/movie-service.yml` nests the keys under `spring:`.
